name: Monster Tamer
hook: Catch critters in the grass. Battle another tamer.
how: Walk into a wild critter in the tall grass and time your throw to catch it. Then battle another tamer turn by turn: pick a move, mind the types (Ember beats Leaf, Leaf beats Tide, Tide beats Ember), and level up your team.
controls: WASD or arrows to walk (or tap to walk, drag for a thumb stick), tap or Space to throw, tap a move or press 1–3 in battle
uses: Your team and its levels are saved to you, so they're there next time.
The host's browser runs the wild critters and every battle turn; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot tamer battles you when you're alone.
Both tamers see the same field, the same critters and the same battle.
Most battles won, shown after every battle.
ideas: Add a water type that lives in the pond
Let critters evolve into a bigger form at level 10
Add a shop that sells healing berries
